text: Debugging is an essential skill for every programmer. When you find a bug, the first step is to identify exactly what is going wrong and when it happens. Good debugging tools, such as breakpoints and error messages, can help you locate the problem quickly. However, you should also follow a systematic approach: test one change at a time and check the result before moving on. Logging is another useful strategy, because it records what your program does while it runs. These logs often reveal the cause of a bug that is hard to find. With patience and the right methods, you can solve most problems efficiently.
